title: Christianity Does Not Give People Hope

top_liked.text:
Oh, there is hope.  Hope that you finally get to live in nirvana AFTER you die.  Cause this life is all about pain, suffering, and trying to follow strict rules that goes against human nature.

The word "hope" doesn't belong in my vocabulary, never use it while speaking or writing. I do believe in taking action and changing myself and my life, not hoping that it'll just happen by magic one day.
Hope is for the lazy ones.

top_discussed.author: @jenna2431
top_discussed.text: Christianity gives comfort USING hope. But it's the same as giving a child a pacifier. It's calming for a time until the distress level goes up again. And it's the fake of a real boob. You don't learn how to self-sooth until it's "taken away".
